'''The Skylight Market''' was an outdoor business that operated in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. There, individual stalls offered several kinds of objects, some of which were exotic or illegal.
